## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `f81aab8af16fe3fff4b3234d4acf124cd110f076`
Local-runs: probe — the card's acceptance greps (`git grep -n '项目总监' -- .claude/skills`, `git grep -n '总监席' -- .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`) and `wc -l` on the eight head blobs; read-only, no gate family rerun
Scope: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`, `references/seat-lifecycle.md`, `references/seat-post-protocol.md`, `references/dispatch-runbook.md`, `references/execution-duties.md`, `references/lanes/director.md`, `references/lanes/skills.md`, `references/rest-channel.md` + `references/platform-readings.md` 〈断粮检测与跨墙恢复〉 (the no-orphan-timer rule the deleted hand-over step 8 pointed at), `references/seat-lifecycle.md` 〈停止条件与待命〉 (the 待命项 the patrol line points at), `references/triage-duties.md` (human floor, unchanged), `references/cross-repo-coordination.md` L44, `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` (ceiling rows and `MAX_TABLE_ROW_BYTES`, read, not changed)

Spec read: card #25379 body (the maintainer's words 「同意，你现在就立卡派发处理。」, the six Wanted items, the one-sentence rule, Acceptance, out-of-scope) and its one comment (the `Claim:` with the File surface). Diff read as `git diff origin/main...origin/claude/project-thread-hxtlri` from merge-base `448374d3`. Check-runs on this head read at 2026-10-23T05:25Z.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **Item 1 (seat post = stub) — lands.** `seat-lifecycle.md` 〈座位贴协议〉 +2 (L27 「项目席的贴是存根,只留他账号要读的;模板见 `seat-post-protocol.md`」, L28 「存根外的姿态、台账与轮报住项目;标题、assignee、坐席审计评论与跨账号移交简报照旧」) and `seat-post-protocol.md` 〈贴的四段与派生视图〉 +2 (L17 the four stub items 「在座账号与项目 · 上任时刻 · 热文件串行队 · 指针行「姿态台账住项目」」, L18 the optional wall note 「预计 HH:MM 恢复」 and the four refresh moments). Every element the card lists is present: seated account, project, seating time, serial queue, pointer line, optional wall note; posture/ledger/shift narrative/round reports out of the post; title, assignee, seating audit comment and the cross-account hand-over brief kept. Correct.
2. **Item 2 (dispatch order in the thread's opening message) — lands.** `dispatch-runbook.md` 〈卡线程〉 L140 「派发令由 coordinator 写进卡线程开场消息,⛔ 不落共享目录;卡上派发评论留一行指针」 replaces the shared-directory line. The three parts of the card's item (coordinator writes it when opening, the mount file no longer required, the card's dispatch comment keeps one pointer line) are all there. The PR spells the mount as a prohibition (⛔) where the card said "no longer required"; tighter than asked, consistent with the one-sentence rule (the project keeps the orders). Correct.
3. **Item 3 (branch named before the thread opens) — correctly NOT written.** The handshake lines L141–L143 are byte-identical to `main`; no claim-first order, no probe-push drop, `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` untouched. The PR body presents options A/B/C and says 「⛔ none picked here」 and 「照派发令交席位汇入决裁批」; the disproof (A2) is measured on this thread. This is the shape the dispatch order asked for and the shape 「必须人工决裁」 requires: the `needs_decision` goes to the maintainer's ruling batch, not to any ruling thread or delegated path. Verified: no added line in the diff opens, reopens or references a 代裁/自裁/裁决线程 path; the only ruling-adjacent added text is the rename 「决裁勤务归总监席」 (`lanes/skills.md` L12) and the renamed SKILL.md L274–L276, whose content (「⛔ 无 Routine/cron」, 「总监席是唯一裁决者 … ⛔ 无子代理无自述」) is unchanged. `triage-duties.md` has zero diff; its human floor (L95–L96, L103, L115, L120) is intact.
4. **Item 4 (wake = events + one patrol per project) — lands, with the deleted lines as payment.** SKILL.md L70–L71 「席位两形:Routine 席与项目席(会话是车道项目的线程);细则见 `references/seat-lifecycle.md`」 / 「项目席唤醒 = PR 订阅事件 + 每项目一个巡查 routine;⛔ 无自绑 cron、无 `send_later` 链」; `seat-lifecycle.md` L96 「项目席巡查 routine 每 2–4 小时跑各车道待命项;撞墙只留存根注记,⛔ 无跨墙定时器链」; `execution-duties.md` 〈收集〉 ①② scoped to 「Routine 席」 with 「项目席由事件与巡查 routine 唤醒」. The `subscribe_pr_activity` rule (execution-duties L156) is untouched. The payment lines are exactly the three the card names as Routine-seat-only (acceptance bullet 3): the 自绑 cron Routine line, the `send_later` accelerator line, the three-line cross-wall timer chain (fixed-point timer / hourly cron / delete-after-first-fire), plus hand-over step 8 (`list_triggers` inventory of the 入座 Routine, which no longer exists in the protocol) and the merge of two 〈座位 Routine 创建〉 fact lines into one (L60; the 「不挂 repo sources」 mechanism remains as the reading in `platform-readings.md` L446). No rule is lost that the Routine form still relies on: the Routine seat's wake is the maintainer-created UI Routine (seat-post-protocol L58, L65 「档位与 cron 是维护者在 UI 上的可调项」), its liveness read is `last_fired`/`next_run` (L26), its 巡检 opener is still `list_triggers` (execution-duties ①), the no-orphan-timer rule stays at platform-readings L449 「⇒ 绑定会话一死:先删旧 Routine、再从新会话重建,⛔ 永不留孤儿」, and the recovery playbook keeps its steps (L95) ending 「照常跑轮」. One form the card did not name is affected; see ③-2.
5. **Item 5 (round report = thread checklist) — lands.** `seat-lifecycle.md` L71 「项目席轮报 = 卡线程清单,⛔ 不逐轮发聊天表;五项健康指标进总监项目的每日摘要」, placed beside the Routine-form report line L70, with the five figures (L74–L78) unchanged. Correct.
6. **Item 6 (naming) — lands within the claim's file surface.** `git grep -n '项目总监' -- .claude/skills` on the head: no hit (four hits on `main`: SKILL.md L56, L274, `lanes/director.md` L1, `lanes/skills.md` L12). `git grep -n '总监席' -- .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`: L56 (the `director` row, 「以总监席身份运行 … 所在项目即「总监项目」」) and L274–L276, i.e. L56 and L274's successors, as acceptance bullet 2 asks. 「车道项目」 defined on the `domain` row (L54), 「总监项目」 on the `director` row (L56). GitHub's board → 「看板(org Project)」 at SKILL.md L33 (红线; 「任何」 dropped to fit the cap, meaning unchanged) and `rest-channel.md` L62 (the line the card cites as L78). 「项目协调者」 has no hit on this head because `coordinator.md` does not exist until PR #25255 lands; deferred as the card itself foresees. Deviation reported by the dev: `cross-repo-coordination.md` L44 still says 「org Project 只是维护者的聚合视图」; outside item 6's citation and outside the claim's file surface, so leaving it is correct for this PR (fix in ③-6).
7. **The one-sentence rule** (GitHub keeps what another account reads; the project keeps the working layer) is carried by the two 〈座位贴协议〉 lines, not restated elsewhere; consistent with SKILL.md's 「⛔ 不另抄」 discipline.
8. **Line budget, ratchet, byte caps — hold.** Per-file `wc -l` on the head blobs equals the base blobs for all eight: SKILL.md 318/318, seat-lifecycle 96/96, seat-post-protocol 91/91, dispatch-runbook 241/241, execution-duties 187/187, director 72/72, skills 32/32, rest-channel 82/82 (+22/−22). Ceiling rows on `main` (319, 96, 91, 241, 188, 72, 33, 82) all ≥ landed counts; `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` is not in the diff and no file shrank, so no row needed lowering. Widest added prose line 119 bytes (cap 120); the two edited SKILL.md table rows 143 and 145 bytes against `MAX_TABLE_ROW_BYTES` 342 for SKILL.md. The `cross-repo-coordination.md` rename proposed in ③-6 measures 119 bytes.
9. **Tier H, id-lint, scope.** No Tier H path in the diff (`AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `docs/NORTH-STAR.md`, `skills/**`, `.github/workflows/**`, CODEOWNERS all absent). No issue number in any added line. No file outside the claim's File surface. Seat posts untouched. `.claude/settings.json`/`.claude/hooks/**` untouched.
10. **Pointers resolve.** `references/seat-lifecycle.md` (SKILL.md L70), `seat-post-protocol.md` (seat-lifecycle L27), `references/lanes/director.md` (SKILL.md L56), `director.md` (lanes/skills.md L12) all exist on the head; 「各车道待命项」 (seat-lifecycle L96) resolves to 〈停止条件与待命〉 L89–L90 in the same file.
11. **PR shape.** Draft, base `main`, body first line is the project attribution block then `Fixes #25379` (merge should close the card: items 1, 2, 4, 5, 6 land; item 3 is the maintainer's ruling, not an unimplemented half, and the coordinator.md pointer waits on another PR by the card's own text); `Clause-②: no`; `Metadata-protocol: none`; `## 维护者速读(草稿)` present in Chinese; `skip-changeset` label on; not flipped ready, not queued.

### ② Semver level

No published package is touched (`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` only); `Clause-②: no` on the body matches a diff with no schema or `exports` change; `skip-changeset` is the correct form for a rule-text-only PR in this repo (review-checklist 〈范围与 changeset〉), and the `Check Changeset` check-run on this head is `success`. Consistent; no semver level applies.

### ③ Boundary flags

1. **Item 3 → maintainer's ruling batch, one letter wanted.** The PR leaves the 〈卡线程〉 handshake unchanged and names A (coordinator reads the branch from `get_session` at spawn, seat claims, thread verifies), B (today's handshake minus the probe push; touches `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`, outside this surface) and C (claim with `Branch: pending`, filled by body edit; conflicts with 「认领评论时间戳是唯一仲裁」). ⛔ Not picked by the PR, ⛔ not picked here; the seat files it for the maintainer per 「必须人工决裁」. Note for the seat: `dispatch-runbook.md` L146 on this head still says 「终报 `needs_decision` ⇒ 席位交 coordinator 开 `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` 裁决线程」 — that is PR #25348's hunk (revoke delegated rulings), untouched here; this PR's own routing follows the dispatch order, not L146.
2. **The deleted 自绑 cron line was not Routine-form-only by its wording.** `main` SKILL.md L70 read 「入座即建唯一自绑 cron Routine(`create_trigger`,`own_followup`)作默认唤醒」 — a default for any seated session. After this PR the two named forms are 「Routine 席」 (maintainer-created UI Routine) and 「项目席」 (project thread); a seat in a plain direct session that is neither — SKILL.md L74 still says 「分诊席跑普通直连会话」 — has no written wake rule. The card ordered this deletion (acceptance bullet 3 names the three lines as the payment), so this is a spec consequence, not a PR defect. Maintainer's word wanted on one of: (a) direct sessions are summoned and manual, as the 总监席 already is (then nothing to write), or (b) a one-line scope note (paid by a deletion) naming the triage seat's form.
3. **Placement vs acceptance bullet 1.** 「`dispatch-runbook.md` 〈卡线程〉 carries items 2–4」: on this head 〈卡线程〉 carries item 2 only; item 4 lives in SKILL.md L71 + seat-lifecycle L96 + execution-duties ①; item 3 is deferred. The "which form applies when" condition is SKILL.md L70's parenthetical 「会话是车道项目的线程」, and seat-lifecycle L27 uses 项目席 without redefining it; the chain resolves through L70's pointer and respects ⛔ no second copy. Acceptable as landed; the seat should say so in its ACCEPT rather than treat the bullet literally.
4. **The patrol line's pointer is slightly narrower than the card's parenthetical.** 「跑各车道待命项」 → 〈停止条件与待命〉 L89–L90 covers unlock scan, hold release, awaiting-landing (在飞/已入队 PR 跟到 MERGED), findings, cross-lane memos; the card's 「stale premise」 is the pre-dispatch check at execution-duties L13, not a standby item, and the wall note is carried by L96 itself. Second commit `f81aab8a` chose the defined term over a new list; no fix demanded, maintainer may accept or ask for 「含前提过时检查」 (fits: L96 is 108 bytes).
5. **Deferred until PR #25255 lands (card's own schedule):** the `coordinator.md` pointer and the 「项目协调者」→「协调者」 rename inside it; the stale word 「派发令文件」 at `dispatch-runbook.md` L135 (beside #25255's L136 hunk). The seat must re-run both acceptance greps and `wc -l` after that follow-up commit; this record covers head `f81aab8a` only. Two known merge interactions: #25255 deletes SKILL.md L274 (this PR only renames it; the deletion wins), and #25348/#25247 move SKILL.md's count (319/317) while this PR holds 318 — re-measure whichever lands last.
6. **Residual 「org Project」 wording outside the surface:** `references/cross-repo-coordination.md` L44 「org Project 只是维护者的聚合视图」. Exact fix, line-neutral, 119 bytes: 「- 规则 5:一块板不设第二跟踪器:pm 标签就是状态机,看板(org Project)只是维护者的聚合视图。」. Fold into the post-#25255 follow-up commit or a one-line card; not a FAIL item because item 6 cites only `rest-channel.md` and the claim's File surface excludes this file.
7. **Red line vs working layer.** SKILL.md L33 「⛔ GitHub 之外永不维护跟踪状态」 now sits beside seat-lifecycle L28 「存根外的姿态、台账与轮报住项目」. Read as the card's one-sentence rule intends — 跟踪状态 = the card state machine (labels, assignee, `Claim:`/`Release:`), which stays on GitHub; posture/ledger/reports are the working layer — the two do not conflict, but a reader may want 跟踪状态 glossed. Not asked by the card; flagged only.
8. **Dev-reported deviations, both accepted:** the body's HTML-comment attribution line (`os-dev.md` 〈干净收尾〉 forbids HTML comments; the project relay inserts it; measured as kept byte-for-byte on sibling PRs); `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions` first exited 3 as a PREREQUISITE on `2b1450c` and was cleared by building the two packages — the recorded 20/20 pass is on this head.
9. **Check-runs on this head, read twice.** First read 2026-10-23T05:25Z: 31 completed, none failed, 7 `in_progress`. Second read at 2026-10-23T05:27Z: all 40 completed, none failed — `success` on Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check, Lint · ESLint, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · CI, release & engine gates, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · scoped ×3, Type Check · workspace / source gates / consumer gates / debt ledger, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Check Changeset, Check PR Size, Check Documentation Links, Part-of PR must not also close its card, No other open PR may claim the same issue, No other open PR may claim the same single-writer path, The card this PR closes must claim this branch, Auto Label, filter, Test Core, Dogfood Regression Gate; the remainder `skipped` by path filter (Build Core, Build Docs, Console Pin Gate, Dogfood Verify CLI, Temporal Conformance, the matrix shards, the two opt-in harnesses, and the duplicate-workflow rows). All green on the full set, not the required subset.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-hxtlri`
Reviewed-by: `session_01REMuzhz6MWRjg8uohedMnM`

**VERDICT: PASS**
